beats.narration_text: Hej — this is Liam, in for Komal, for Madison's weekly update. Team Madison has three tracks this week. Gavia's desktop app is complete — invasive vegetation is in the Model menu. An influencer-vetting app is in late design and still needs a name. And they are working with the social media team on a plan to start promoting the projects.

beats.narration_text: Vegnet looks for four shoreline plants: purple loosestrife, common reed, water chestnut, yellow flag iris. It boxes a stand, names the species, and a person still reviews. Their own changelog calls it an early model. An early model is not a census of the lake.
